description: Quantises a binary pitch track onto a set of (possibly fractional) MIDI pitches and emits the correction as a BINARY TRANSPOSITION FILE (.trn: RIFF FLOAT mono at the analysis window rate, 'is a transpos file' property, one ratio per window - 698 ratios from the 698-window probe, re-verified tranche 24). Arity-0 data entry (the repitch combineb pattern): the pitchfile rides the pre-output aux slot, the q-set file rides after the output ('repitch quantise 2 pitchfile out.trn qset.txt [-o]'). The ratio at each window = quantised_pitch/tracked_pitch (probe sample 1.065-1.072 on the wobbling fixture). MUSICALLY VERIFIED end-to-end (tranche 22 chain B, re-run all-curated in tranche 24): applied back via curated transposef 4, a continuous ~261 Hz wobble snaps to stepped plateaus on the C-major set (296.6/257.1/247.2 Hz vs the continuous original). Q-set values CDP-enforced 0-127 ('ERROR: Pitch value out of range (0.0 - 127.0) in quantisation set' verbatim at 300); inline values refuse ('Can't open textfile 60 to read data.' - file only). -o (all-octave duplication) is live (data chunk differs, verified). Deterministic (byte-identical data chunks 1.3 s apart). Mode 1 (same argv, pitchfile output for the synth/vowels path) verified running - sibling, execute()/future-curation.
musical_use: THE pitch-corrector / scale-mapper of the pitch-data layer, now curated end to end: getpitch 1 (curated) -> THIS -> transposef 4 (curated) = autotune-with-formants-intact, where YOU define the scale. Write any pitch set with write_data_file() - diatonic (60 62 64 65 67 69 71), pentatonic, quarter-tone (60 60.5 61...), a single pitch (drone-lock), or a chord - and pass all_octaves=true to make it register-free. Because the output is data, one correction can be applied to OTHER material: quantise a lead vocal's track, apply the .trn to its doubling track for matched correction; or apply a voice's quantise-correction to a synth pad analysis for parallel harmony that breathes with the voice. Sparse sets give hard melodic reduction (everything gravitates to chord tones); dense microtonal sets give gentle drift-correction. Chain with curated repitch vibrato 2 (quantise first, re-add vibrato after) to avoid the robotic flat-line.

pitchfile.description: BINARY pitch data (.frq) - repitch getpitch 1's side file ('pitch_trace.frq' in the session root resolves by bare name) or another transform's .frq output (pass its graph-relative path, e.g. 'graphs/<id>/n1_repitch-smooth.frq'). Typed infile: text pitch data refuses 'Application doesn't work with this type of infile.'; a .trn refuses identically (verified both, tranche 24).

qset.description: Text file of MIDI pitch values (one per line, fractional allowed) defining the quantisation set - write with write_data_file(). Values CDP-enforced 0-127 (verbatim refusal pinned). Rides the argv slot AFTER the output file. GARBAGE-THROUGH: a non-numeric line is silently tolerated (exit 0, verified) - keep the file clean.

all_octaves.description: Duplicate the q-set in all octave transpositions (register-free scale). Live: -o render differs from the plain run (verified).

examples.description: Snap a wobbly voice to C major, ready for curated apply-back.

examples.description: Drone-lock: collapse all pitch movement to one target.
examples.expected_use: onenote.txt = '57\n' (A3). The .trn cancels every deviation from A - melodic material becomes a reciting tone with living micro-articulation.

known_issues: Output is DATA (.trn), not audio: duration pre-flight is skipped, verification is exists+non-empty, and it cannot be auditioned - apply it via curated repitch transposef 4 (pass this output's session-relative path as 'transposition').

Window-count discipline: the .trn carries one ratio per window of the SOURCE pitchfile; transposef 4 does NOT length-check (tranche 22 landmine) - keep extraction, quantisation and apply-back on the same analysis.

Q-SET GARBAGE-THROUGH (verified): a non-numeric line in the set is silently ignored (exit 0); out-of-range values refuse verbatim ('Pitch value out of range (0.0 - 127.0) in quantisation set'). Inline set values refuse ('Can't open textfile 60 to read data.') - file form only.
Marker windows (-1 unpitched / -2 silence) pass through untouched - quantisation applies only to pitched windows.
duration_model 'static' is a schema placeholder (data output; the .trn spans the pitchfile's window count).
Deterministic (byte-identical data chunks, re-verified tranche 24). Sibling mode 1 (pitchfile out, for the synth/vowels resynthesis path) verified running - use submode 1 via execute() until curated.
